description: Code Engine build configurations: build a container image in IBM Cloud from Git (no local Docker needed). Identify a build with project_id and build_name. To run one, use ce_build_run with action start. Call get_schema with name ce_build for every action's fields.

action.description: list: List build configurations. | get: Get one build configuration. Needs build_name. | create: Create a build. output_secret must be a registry secret with push access. Needs build_name, output_image, output_secret, source_url. | update: Update source_url, source_revision, strategy_type, or output_image on an existing build. Needs build_name. | delete: Delete a build configuration. Needs build_name.

build_name.description: Build configuration name, from ce_build action list.

output_secret.description: Registry secret with push access (e.g. icr-push-secret)

project_id.description: Project id or name, from ce_project action list.

source_context_dir.description: Subdirectory within the source that contains the Dockerfile (optional)

strategy_spec_file.description: Dockerfile path relative to context (default: Dockerfile)

name: ce_build
